clue.text: The oceans supply a source of power

definitions.meaning: the main is an old poetic word for the open sea, so the plural stands for the oceans
the household electricity supply from the grid

explanation.definitionFit: Poets call the sea the main, and the domestic electricity supply is also called by this plural word.

clue.text: Instruction to lay more off

definitions.meaning: a period of teaching
to take more off is to put ..., read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: A class is a unit of teaching; read as LESS ON the letters describe taking more away.

clue.text: Two fools take in a murderer

explanation.surface: A pair of idiots harbour a killer.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a killer, usually of a public figure.

clue.text: Got up, had a meal and was in thepink

parts.note: rose is the past tense of rise, to get up

explanation.surface: Someone got up, ate, and felt in fine health.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue runs 'the' and 'pink' together; it means 'in the pink', which here is read literally as pink-coloured rather than healthy.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseate means rose-coloured, the shade of pink.

clue.text: Mad enough to break the saucepan

explanation.surface: Someone is angry enough to smash a pan.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot is an eccentric or crazy person; used here as an adjective meaning crazy.

clue.text: Main message broadcast to children

definitions.meaning: the flag a ship flies before sailing, a signal at sea (the main)
a long-running BBC children's television programme

explanation.walkthrough: BLUE PETER is both the blue-and-white signal flag meaning a ship is about to sail and a famous British children's TV show named after it.
explanation.definitionFit: The flag is a signal sent over the sea, and the British television programme for youngsters carries the same name.

clue.text: Photograph what the armed bandit may do

definitions.meaning: to snap a picture

definitions.text: what the armed bandit may do
definitions.meaning: an armed robber might fire his gun

explanation.definitionFit: Snapping a picture and firing a gun share the idiom.

clue.text: Material for military exercises

definitions.meaning: a strong twilled cotton fabric
parade-ground training for soldiers

explanation.definitionFit: Drill is a hard-wearing cotton cloth and also soldiers' marching practice.

clue.text: Many a politician is wet

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, hence many

explanation.walkthrough: 'Wet' in British slang also means feeble, which the surface leans on; here it means moist.
explanation.definitionFit: Damp means slightly moist.

clue.text: Where the citizen has a right to be tense

definitions.text: Where the citizen has a right to be
definitions.meaning: a citizen belongs within a nation
agitated or anxious

explanation.definitionFit: A citizen lives within a nation, and the idiom also means agitated and nervous.

clue.text: One of the toxophilists of Ambridge

definitions.text: One of the toxophilists of Ambridge

parts.words: One of the toxophilists of Ambridge
parts.note: toxophilists are lovers of the bow, and Ambridge is the village in the BBC radio soap whose central family share the bowman's surname

explanation.walkthrough: The Archers is a long-running British radio soap opera set in the village of Ambridge; a toxophilite is a devotee of archery.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowman is a toxophilite, and the central family of the Ambridge soap bear that surname.

clue.text: Where to lay our responsibility

parts.note: split into two words, the letters say the duty is placed upon ourselves

explanation.definitionFit: An onus is a burden or duty, and split as ON US it says where that burden falls.

clue.text: The fastest and best stuff to get high on

explanation.definitionFit: Maximum velocity is the quickest a thing can go.

clue.text: Pharmacist may provide such a container

definitions.meaning: one who makes up prescriptions
a holder that releases its contents a measure at a time

explanation.definitionFit: A chemist who makes up medicines dispenses them, and a holder giving out soap or tape is also so called.

clue.text: The result of a bombshell in recent City practices

definitions.meaning: a huge explosion
the 1986 deregulation of the London Stock Exchange

explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district; its 1986 deregulation was nicknamed the Big Bang.
explanation.definitionFit: A bomb produces an enormous explosion, and London's 1986 financial deregulation took the same nickname.

clue.text: He sings the first few notes with sonorous quality

parts.note: a bar of music holds a few notes
I is the Roman numeral one, the first
tone is the quality of a sound

explanation.surface: A singer opens with some notes in a rich voice.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in the order 'few notes', 'the first', then 'sonorous quality'.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer with a voice between tenor and bass.

clue.text: Colonist who is fully paid up

definitions.meaning: a pioneer who makes a home in new land
one who settles a bill or account

explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer settles new land, and one who settles a debt pays it in full.

clue.text: Eton is an unusual place to find an Eastern European

indicators.note: an unusual version of these letters is a rearrangement of them

explanation.surface: A Baltic native seems out of place at Eton, the English public school.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is a famous English boarding school; 'unusual' makes the anagram of ETON IS AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonia is a Baltic state in eastern Europe, and its people are named after it.

clue.text: Once more a righteous man is in opposition

explanation.surface: Again a virtuous man takes a contrary stand.
explanation.definitionFit: To be against something is to oppose it.

clue.text: Just playing the game

definitions.meaning: fair-minded
taking part in sport, or behaving fairly

explanation.definitionFit: A fair person is a good sport, and the word also describes taking part in a game.

clue.text: African tribesmen, each claiming to be sanctimonious

parts.note: pi is slang for pious or sanctimonious

explanation.surface: Tribal warriors who each say they are holier than thou.
explanation.walkthrough: PI is British slang for self-righteously pious.
explanation.definitionFit: An impi is a Zulu regiment or band of warriors.

clue.text: Instant credit

definitions.meaning: a moment, as in 'just a jiffy'
buying on account, 'on the slate'

explanation.definitionFit: British slang uses the word for a moment and for buying on credit.

clue.text: Hazel carries it to puss and her kittens

explanation.surface: Hazel takes something along to a cat and its litter.
explanation.walkthrough: Hazel reads as a woman's name, but it is the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The hazel tree bears dangling flower clusters in late winter.

clue.text: Coal burning fast on such days

definitions.meaning: a glowing piece of coal in a dying fire
... Days are church days of fasting and prayer

explanation.definitionFit: A glowing coal fragment shares its name with the quarterly fasting days of the church calendar.

clue.text: Part of the foot regiments should be on parade

definitions.meaning: the arched middle of the upper foot
soldiers marching together keep pace

explanation.definitionFit: The arched upper foot has this name, and troops marching in unison are said to keep pace this way.

clue.text: Never instantaneously

definitions.meaning: read literally, at no time at all
very quickly

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means very quickly, but taken literally it says on no occasion.

clue.text: Intends to make money

definitions.meaning: plans or signifies
financial resources

explanation.definitionFit: To intend is to signify a purpose, and the plural noun also denotes wealth or resources.

clue.text: Restaurant where I meet Stan by arrangement

indicators.note: putting the letters into a new arrangement is a rearrangement of them

explanation.surface: Someone names the cafe where they are meeting Stan.
explanation.walkthrough: An estaminet is a small French cafe-bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A small French cafe serving drinks and simple food is a modest eatery.
